findings.title: Admin cookie can be derived from shipped defaults when required secrets are absent
findings.scope: Actual auth module accepted its deterministic default token in the empty-environment fixture. The media route treats this separate cookie as super-admin and may use a service client. Production configuration was NOT inspected; deployed exploitability is conditional, not claimed.
findings.fix: Require server-only admin secrets at startup, remove default credentials, require verified platform-admin session for cross-tenant service access; fail closed when configuration is missing.
findings.retest: Unset either/both secrets: startup/auth must deny; forge default-derived cookie: preview/download remain 401/403; valid tenant A cannot read tenant B.

findings.title: Unsigned Master upstream video request is incompatible with signed-only Gateway
findings.scope: Actual Master GET and actual Sales verifier: owned approved fixture returns 502 after upstream 401. Next/auth/database transports are isolated doubles; no deployed browser run.
findings.fix: Authorize the server-to-server fetch after owned-output checks; use scoped signing or a server-only token, preserve Range semantics and avoid exposing master token.
findings.retest: Approved and owned review preview, thumbnail, library and full download succeed against hardened Gateway; cross-tenant and expired access deny.

findings.title: Media normalization discards signed query; private bucket still resolves as public
findings.scope: Actual media-url module strips sig/exp/tid from signed Gateway URL. Actual resolver emits a public creatives URL although migration makes bucket private.
findings.fix: Use owned application media IDs and authenticated proxy/signed storage delivery; preserve validated signature parameters without trusting arbitrary hosts. Inventory/backfill legacy public_url values before migration.
findings.retest: Signed URL survives normalization; fresh and historical images render in private bucket; expired links renew only after tenant authorization.

findings.title: Old subscription deletion bypasses subscription mismatch guard
findings.scope: Actual POST + actual PL/pgSQL: tenant on sub_current downgraded to free by deletion of sub_obsolete. Existing other-bot SQL test passes sub_OLD directly and misses route nulling.
findings.fix: Pass event subscription ID even on deletion; clear local ID inside the atomic decision only after matching current subscription.
findings.retest: Run signed obsolete deletion and incomplete_expired update through actual POST; current plan/subscription unchanged; valid current deletion downgrades.

findings.title: invoice.payment_failed with invoice status open does not suspend
findings.scope: Actual signed invoice failure with status=open returned 200/applied but suspended_at stayed null.
findings.fix: Normalize event type separately from invoice lifecycle status, then apply delinquency policy using authoritative subscription state.
findings.retest: invoice.payment_failed open/draft variants suspend according to policy; payment recovery clears only Stripe-owned suspension; manual/security suspension persists.

findings.title: Paid invoice can downgrade plan and replace current subscription with an obsolete one
findings.scope: Actual paid invoice without subscription-level plan metadata changed pro to starter. An obsolete paid invoice replaced sub_current with sub_obsolete; mismatch guard only covers selected negative statuses.
findings.fix: Resolve invoice subscription using the pinned Stripe API schema; load authoritative current plan/subscription instead of guessing starter. Enforce identity on all subscription-affecting events.
findings.retest: Metadata-free current paid invoice retains pro; obsolete invoice success/failure/deletion has no entitlement effect; test invoice parent.subscription_details for supported API version.

findings.title: Unpaid completed Checkout is treated as active entitlement
findings.scope: Actual POST with status=complete/payment_status=unpaid cleared prior Stripe suspension. Payment status is absent from modeled object.
findings.fix: Gate activation on supported payment/subscription entitlement policy, including asynchronous payment results; completion alone is insufficient for a paid plan.
findings.retest: Unpaid asynchronous Checkout cannot unsuspend; paid/no_payment_required approved trial paths behave according to explicit policy.

findings.title: Private signed media is publicly cacheable beyond signature lifetime
findings.scope: Exact Gateway media handler over loopback HTTP returned public one-day caching for signed private fixture. No CDN/cache leakage was attempted; potential expiry bypass through shared-cache reuse.
findings.fix: Emit private,no-store for protected content, or define a reviewed cache strategy bound to authorization/expiry; keep public assets separate.
findings.retest: Private image/video full/range/HEAD responses have protected cache policy; expiry/revocation deny with shared cache present in isolated staging.

findings.title: Gateway byte-range parser accepts out-of-bounds ranges
findings.scope: Exact handler returned 206 for HEAD bytes=999-1000 on a 21-byte fixture; should return 416. Parser also lacks suffix/multiple/malformed handling; GET error/crash consequences not claimed without isolated process evidence.
findings.fix: Validate unit, finite integer bounds, suffix/open ranges; clamp end; return 416 with bytes */size; handle read-stream errors.
findings.retest: Valid range bytes match; suffix ranges work; invalid/multiple/oversized ranges cannot terminate process or hang client.

findings.title: Gateway bearer secret is compared case-insensitively
findings.scope: Actual verifier accepted the randomly generated master token with all letter case changed. Bearer scheme may be case-insensitive; credential bytes must not be.
findings.fix: Parse scheme separately, compare exact credential bytes with constant-time digests.
findings.retest: Bearer scheme casing accepted, token casing change denied; empty/unconfigured token denied.

findings.title: 60/60 mixes static checks, weak browser checks and assertion-free callbacks
findings.scope: All 60 callbacks classified independently. 34 browser-oriented checks, 7 unit, 11 static, 8 unverified. Categories describe mechanism, not 34 independently verified passes.
findings.fix: Expose evidence class and required assertions per acceptance item. Fail on empty optional branches; record deployment/source identity and network/DB receipts.
findings.retest: Pending-job F5, two tabs, actual DB draft save/reopen, signed media tenant negatives and mobile controls must run in seeded isolated stack.

findings.title: Secret scanner bypasses flagged lines and treats Git failure as success
findings.scope: Actual scanner in VM ignored synthetic Bearer credential when same line referenced process.env, and returned zero on Git read failure. No actual credentials printed.
findings.fix: Never skip a whole line due to marker text; use scoped placeholder handling and fail closed on scanner/Git errors. Validate scanner using synthetic canaries.
findings.retest: Mixed env/secret line, comments, nested docs, malformed Git context, deleted files and full delivery staged diff; report scope explicitly.

findings.title: Stripe ledger has no explicit RLS or tenant read policy
findings.scope: Actual migration yields relrowsecurity=false. Repository default-privilege lockdown revokes anon/auth table privileges, so public access is NOT demonstrated. Risk depends on actual migration creator/default ACL drift.
findings.fix: Enable RLS, revoke anon/auth explicitly, keep server-only ledger unless tenant policy is required; verify actual role grants and function ownership.
findings.retest: Anon/auth cross-tenant select/insert/update/delete denied; only service role applies atomic events; catalog assertions on clean migration stack.

findings.title: Independent customer capacity and recovery remain unmeasured
findings.scope: Source defaults are configuration, not verified simultaneous businesses. Existing load report distinguishes request-thread load and synthetic queue jobs; its WA health timeouts are historical, no current rerun.
findings.fix: Measure 3-5 seeded tenants across real app/queue/worker/storage, with providers stubbed; establish pool budget, eligible browser count, admission/backpressure and restore recovery.
findings.retest: Collect p95 latency, connection use, queue oldest age, RAM, retry/dedup, health under load and crash recovery before pilot.

findings.title: Enabled Creative DNA adapter declares transformation but only enriches metadata
findings.scope: Actual enabled adapter adds version/bridge-ready markers; no three strategies, nine hooks or owned-asset validation. Research TypeScript remains documentation.
findings.fix: Keep flag off; agree versioned schema, validation, selection persistence and asset/claim constraints before executable integration. Remove misleading ready marker until contract satisfied.
findings.retest: 3x3 cardinality, selected-hook membership, tenant asset ownership, verified claims, product/logo SHA, mode separation and rollback flag.

findings.title: Postgres TLS certificate verification defaults off
findings.scope: Static code default permits unverified server certificate; production env not inspected.
findings.fix: Require certificate verification and documented CA in production; development exception explicit.
findings.retest: Valid CA connects; invalid/self-signed unexpected certificate fails; readiness reports failure without secret leakage.
